appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Telehealth Follow-up Enrollment Trend' in large, bold, black text.
A subtitle in smaller gray text reads 'Reported window shown in the dashboard summary'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Enrolled patients' with a scale from 260 to 380, marked with gridlines at 260, 290, 320, 350, and 380.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with tick marks for 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020.
A single teal-colored line connects four data points, one for each year from 2017 to 2020.
The data point for 2017 is at the bottom-left of the chart, positioned at approximately 260 enrolled patients.
The data point for 2018 is positioned higher than 2017, at approximately 295 enrolled patients.
The data point for 2019 is positioned higher than 2018, at approximately 330 enrolled patients.

public_definitions: The chart displays the enrollment trend from 2017 to 2020, which is the full review window.
The operational route must be selected based on the pattern observed in this full window.
The three options correspond to: (1) ongoing monitoring for a recent upswing, (2) sustained growth planning for multi-year expansion, or (3) decline-response assessment for a downward trajectory.
uncertain: The chart does not show data for the years 2013-2016, so the full 2013-2020 window is not visible. The decision must be based on the visible data from 2017-2020.
